usageNote: 名词短语！说的是受过特殊训练的精英军人，比普通soldier厉害多了，像特工一样的存在～

examples.en: The mission was carried out by special soldiers trained for jungle warfare.
examples.zh: 这次任务由接受过丛林战训练的特种兵执行。

examples.en: Special soldiers are selected through extremely tough physical and mental tests.
examples.zh: 特种兵通过极其艰苦的体能和心理测试被选拔出来。
